levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد
جعفر بن محمد بن عبد الله

notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الإسناد» takes the whole chain of prev1 (report 2), which has one route and writes its names, so all six names are inherited, in order.
The story's Imam is «أبي عبد الله ... أو أبي جعفر» — the text gives both as alternatives, so they share one level; the Imam speaks («بل ائذنوا له»), so he is the last link.
The inherited «أبيه» is prev1's own last item; the report does not name him further.
